name: RF and Microwave Solid State Devices
description: Review of basics of semiconductor devices. Carrier concentration, band diagram, P-N junction diode, Schottky diode, qualitative description, junction properties, tunnel diode, high frequency application of Schottky diode, Schottky barrier gate FET. GaAs MESFET I‐V characteristics, high electron mobility transistor (HEMT), hetero structures, SOT technologies and MOSFET.
